class.name: SteamAppOwnership
class.brief_description: Current Steam license information for one verified account and app.
class.description: Use [member owns_app] to check an active license. The other values describe the license where Valve supplies the corresponding fields.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: AppID requested by the trusted ownership check.

method.name: get_owns_app
method.description: Whether Steam reports an active license for the requested app.

method.name: get_license_owner_steam_id
method.description: Full decimal SteamID64 of the owner, or an empty string when unavailable.

method.name: get_acquired_at
method.description: Acquisition time text from Steam, or an empty string when unavailable.

method.name: get_expires_at
method.description: Expiration time text or Steam's [code]never[/code] sentinel. Empty when unavailable.

method.name: get_site_license
method.description: Whether Steam reports a PC Café license.

method.name: get_user_canceled
method.description: Whether Steam reports that the user cancelled the license.
